sections.name: requiredNetworkValue
sections.title: Required value check
sections.what: Returns the value if it is present, and throws a fixed error if it is null or undefined.
sections.why: The comment says a missing validated reference is a bug to surface, not a state to render.
sections.watch_out: Callers that receive this error need an error boundary above them, or the whole view breaks.

summary: Returns a value unchanged if it exists, and throws an error with a fixed message if it is null or undefined.
purpose: Stops the network view from using a reference that was supposed to be validated but is missing.
why: The file's comment says validated references must stay present during rendering, so a missing one is treated as a bug to surface.
how: Checks whether the value is null or undefined. If it is, the function throws. Otherwise it returns the same value.
inputs: Any value that may be null or undefined.
outputs: The same value with the missing possibility removed from its type, or an error.
risks: The thrown error stops rendering unless an error boundary above it catches it.
debug: If the error text appears, find the caller that passed the missing value and check the validation step that should have stored it.
